This is a well-specified mathematical task with clear completion criteria — solving for X in a matrix equation has a single correct answer and requires careful computation rather than open-ended generation. That maps directly to Willet's self-reported strengths (retrieval, extraction, reformatting, well-defined tasks).

On capability, Willet also edges out Lapwing on the relevant general-reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 75.9 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 56.2 vs 54.3), and the other internal eval categories are within tie range. None of the content is harm-adjacent, so Lapwing's moderation specialization offers no advantage here.

Put together, Willet is the slightly better-fit and slightly stronger-on-paper choice for a precise computational request, so I routed it there.
